phases.name: Phase 1 · Foundation
phases.goal: Build knowledge across all 8 categories while finishing 4th year.

tasks.title: Download the official 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan PDF
Set up daily flashcards (Anki) for drugs & lab values
Study Management of Care + Safety topics
Study Pharmacology by drug class
tasks.hint: Use the suffix table in Quick reference

tasks.title: Study Physiological Adaptation & Risk Reduction body system by body system
tasks.hint: Cardiac, respiratory, renal, endocrine, neuro, GI

tasks.title: Study Health Promotion, Psychosocial and Basic Care
Do 10–20 practice questions daily on today's topic
Learn the 6 Clinical Judgment steps
Start IELTS Academic / CELBAN practice

phases.name: Phase 2 · Question practice
phases.goal: Move from reading to answering. Questions become the main study method.

tasks.title: 30–50 mixed questions per day
Practise every Next Gen question type
1 full case study per week
Re-study every topic still marked Weak
Book IELTS / CELBAN date
Start NNAS application once eligible
tasks.hint: Request transcripts and syllabi from university early

phases.name: Phase 3 · Intensive
phases.goal: Exam-level practice with a full commercial question bank.

tasks.title: Subscribe to one main question bank (e.g. UWorld)
75–100 timed questions per day
Weekly full-length adaptive mock exam
tasks.hint: Same length & time as the real one

tasks.title: Keep an error notebook
tasks.hint: Why did I miss it? Content or strategy?

tasks.title: Apply for NCLEX eligibility through the Canadian regulator

phases.name: Phase 4 · Final readiness
phases.goal: Polish and get ready for exam day.

tasks.title: Take 1–2 readiness assessments
Weak areas only + lab values / drugs review
Register with Pearson VUE and book the test centre
tasks.hint: Check nearest centre & travel/visa if outside Bangladesh

tasks.title: Practise exam-day schedule: timing, breaks, sleep
Light review only in the last 2 days, then rest
Sit the NCLEX-RN 🎉
